meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加动态图文叠加层，同步字幕与画面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为访谈或播客视频添加专业图文卡片
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic overlays to videos, synced with transcript
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add professional graphic cards to interview or podcast videos

howto.what: 当你提供一个本地谈话类视频（如访谈、播客），Claude 会分析其转录内容，然后设计一系列与语音同步的图形覆盖卡片（如动态标题、下三分之一、数据标注、引用、画中画等），并生成一个最终视频文件，原始视频画面保持不变。
howto.when: 当你提到“graphic overlays”、“on-screen graphics”或要求“包装视频”时触发。

say.text: 给这段采访视频加上标题和下三分之一注释。
say.note: Claude会分析转录并添加卡片。

say.text: 帮我包装这个播客，添加数据标注和画中画。
把这个谈话视频包装成有引用侧面板的样式。
say.note: 卡片样式根据内容设计。

howto.what_en: When you provide a local talking-head video, Claude analyzes the transcript, designs timed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, PiP) synced to speech, and outputs a final video with overlays while the original clip remains untouched.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'graphic overlays', 'on-screen graphics', or 'package my video', or ask to dress up an existing talking-head video.

say_en.text: Add titles and lower-thirds to this interview video.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes transcript and adds cards.

say_en.text: Package this podcast with data callouts and picture-in-picture.
Dress up this talking head with side panel quotes.
